x-openregister._seedDataNote: Schemas only. A register.d fragment declares no objects; the example sets live in lib/Settings/profiles/.

_comment: ADR-037 register fragment, change platform-case-system-document-exchange (REQ-CSDX-002, REQ-CSDX-006, matrix rows plt-23 and plt-24). AgendaItem gains the case it belongs to in the organisation's case system (caseReference). CaseExchangeRecord (slug case-exchange-record) records every fetch from and send to the case system, one line per document with its own status, so a retry sends only what failed.

caseReference.title: Case
caseReference.description: The case this agenda item belongs to in the organisation's case system: its address, its case number and its title. Set by linking the item to a case; decidiq reads the case once to fill the title.

url.title: Case address
url.description: The address of the case in the case system.

identification.title: Case number
identification.description: The case number, such as Z-2026-00412.

title.title: Case title
title.description: The title of the case as the case system names it.

CaseExchangeRecord.title: Case system exchange
CaseExchangeRecord.description: One fetch from or send to the case system, with a line per document and the status of each.
CaseExchangeRecord._authorizationNote: Staff read only. Records are written by decidiq in system context when a document is fetched or the meeting file is sent; nobody writes them by hand, so the write actions stay with administrators.

meeting.title: Meeting
meeting.description: The meeting whose file was sent, or whose agenda item documents were fetched for.

agendaItem.title: Agenda item
agendaItem.description: The agenda item the documents were fetched onto or whose decisions were sent.

direction.title: Direction
direction.description: Fetch brings documents from the case system onto an agenda item; send takes documents to a case.

target.title: Case address
target.description: The address of the case the documents came from or went to.

targetLabel.title: Case
targetLabel.description: The case number or title, as shown on screen.

lines.title: Documents
lines.description: One line per document, each with its own status.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: What the document is: the agenda, an item document, a decision, the decision list, the minutes or the proof package.

source.title: Source
source.description: Where decidiq finds the document again when it is sent a second time.

fileId.title: File
fileId.description: The Nextcloud file, when the document is one.

remoteUrl.title: Address in the case system
remoteUrl.description: The document's address in the case system, once it is there.

status.title: Status
status.description: Pending until the case system answers, then sent or failed.

error.title: Error
error.description: Why the case system refused the document.

confidential.title: Confidential
confidential.description: The document was sent marked confidential.

ground.title: Ground
ground.description: The confidentiality ground it was sent with.

requestedBy.title: Requested by
requestedBy.description: The account that fetched or sent, or system when minutes approval sent it.

requestedAt.title: Requested at
requestedAt.description: When the fetch or send was asked for.
